first.rationale: Activation is down 6% QoQ, the most acute metric. memory_91 (activation messaging) demonstrated reliable week-one engagement lift with proven mechanics. memory_86 (onboarding shortening) showed durable adoption gains. Verifying memory_86 and memory_73 first to confirm onboarding completion dynamics haven't shifted and to rule out whether promotional pricing is necessary before investing in activation. Activation messaging directly addresses the root activation decline without the revenue/margin risk of promotional pricing or the allocation friction of enterprise sales. This preserves optionality: if activation messaging moves the needle, we've solved the core problem; if not, we retain the experiment slot value for pricing response next week. Referral incentives work on established base (memory_57), not helpful for current SMB acquisition pressure.
